def arithmetic_series_sum(a, d, n):
    """Marta keeps a reading log. On the first day of her plan she reads a
    pages, and each following day she reads d more pages than the day before,
    so her daily counts run a, a + d, a + 2*d, and so on down the page of her
    notebook. Rather than tallying day by day, she wants a single quick
    calculation for how many pages she will have read in total once the first
    n days of the plan are complete. a, d, n are ints with n >= 0. Return the
    sum of the first n terms of the arithmetic sequence a, a + d, a + 2*d,
    ..., computed as n * a + d * n * (n - 1) // 2 exactly (0 for n == 0).

    >>> arithmetic_series_sum(1, 1, 5)
    15
    >>> arithmetic_series_sum(3, 0, 4)
    12
    """
